name: Horse race end range
description: Defines a rectangular range for ending the horse race.

fields.name: Width
fields.description: Sets the range width in 8-unit increments.

fields.name: Height
fields.description: Sets the range height in 8-unit increments.

fields.name: Align to Grid
fields.description: When enabled, offsets the range from the actor's position. Otherwise, aligns the position to a 16-unit grid before applying the offset.
